hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Setting sleeve
function: The outer sleeve of the adapter kit that bears on the top of the plug and pushes the slips and element down during the stroke.

tabs.overview: Sized to the plug OD; reused after redress.
